map.Token 用量估算器，按中英文与代码比例估算文本 token 数，提示不同分词: Estimates text tokens from the mix of Chinese, English and code, points out tokenizer differences, and supports context-window and cost accounting for large models.
map.tokens ≈ 中文字数 / 1.5 + 英文词数 / 0.75 + 代码字符: tokens ≈ Chinese characters / 1.5 + English words / 0.75 + code characters
map.混合内容按三类分别折算：中文按字符、英文按词、代码按字符（切分最碎）。这是粗略预: Mixed content is converted in three categories: Chinese by character, English by word, and code by character (which splits most finely). This is a rough budgeting tool; actual values fluctuate by about ±20% with the tokenizer and symbol density, so leave a safety margin when judging whether you approach the context limit.
map.按中英文与代码比例估算文本 token 数，提示不同分词器差异。: Estimate text tokens from the Chinese/English/code mix and highlight tokenizer differences.
map.中文约 1~2 字/token(因模型而异)，英文约 4 字符/token，代码: Chinese is about 1-2 characters per token (model dependent), English about 4 characters per token, and code is denser still.
map.估算用于把控上下文窗口与 API 成本，精确值需对应模型分词器计数。: Use the estimate to control the context window and API cost; exact values require the matching model tokenizer.
map.：一段 500 中文字+200 英文词：中文≈500×1.5=750 token: For a passage with 500 Chinese characters and 200 English words: Chinese ≈ 500×1.5 = 750 tokens, English ≈ 200×1.3 = 260 tokens, about 1010 tokens in total. Real values differ slightly by model tokenizer.
map.为什么中文 token 数不固定？: Why is the Chinese token count not fixed?
map.不同模型对中文的子词切分不同(按字/按词/混合)，同一段中文 token 数可差: Different models split Chinese into subwords differently (by character, by word, or a mix), so the same passage can differ by several times. This estimate only gives the order of magnitude; exact counts need the matching tokenizer.
map.代码为什么更费 token？: Why does code consume more tokens?
map.代码含大量符号、缩进与标识符，信息密度高、子词切分更碎，同等字符数常比自然语言消: Code contains many symbols, indentation and identifiers, so it is information-dense and splits into finer subwords, consuming more tokens than natural language of the same length.
